question: What is the mandatory data retention period for audit logs in the production environment?
contexts: [sec-audit-101] Audit logs in production environments must be retained for a mandatory duration of 365 days in tamper-proof immutable storage before archiving to cold storage.
expected_answer: Production audit logs must be retained for 365 days in tamper-proof immutable storage.

question: What are the minimum password length and MFA requirements for administrative accounts?
contexts: [iam-policy-202] All administrative user accounts must use a minimum password length of 16 characters and enforce hardware-backed Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) on all logins.
expected_answer: Administrative accounts require a minimum password length of 16 characters and mandatory hardware-backed MFA.

question: Which outbound network ports are permitted for backend worker services?
contexts: [net-rules-305] Backend worker nodes are restricted to outbound traffic on port 443 (HTTPS) for API calls and port 5432 (TLS) to designated database subnets. All other egress is blocked.
expected_answer: Permitted outbound ports are port 443 (HTTPS) and port 5432 (TLS) to designated database subnets.

question: What is the maximum allowable Recovery Time Objective (RTO) for Tier-1 mission-critical systems?
contexts: [dr-plan-401] Tier-1 mission-critical services have a strict maximum Recovery Time Objective (RTO) of 15 minutes and a Recovery Point Objective (RPO) of 0 seconds.
expected_answer: The maximum allowable RTO for Tier-1 mission-critical systems is 15 minutes.

question: In which cloud regions is European customer data permitted to be stored?
contexts: [data-residency-502] European Union customer data may only be stored and processed within eu-west-1 (Ireland) and eu-central-1 (Frankfurt) regions to ensure GDPR compliance.
expected_answer: European customer data may only be stored in eu-west-1 (Ireland) and eu-central-1 (Frankfurt).
